request.state:
L01: The outage began at 09:12 and ended at 10:40.
L02: Customers saw a blank page and no error text.
L03: The first responder restarted the front door process.
L04: The restart did not help.
L05: A second responder drained the west rack.
L06: Traffic moved to the east rack and the page came back.
L07: A certificate on the west rack had expired that morning at 09:00.
L08: The expiry was not caught because the reminder went to a mailbox nobody reads.
L09: A new certificate was installed at 11:30.
L10: The west rack was returned to service at 12:05.
L11: The reminder mailbox has been changed to the duty rota.
L12: An audit of every other certificate is scheduled.
L13: No customer data was touched during the outage.
L14: The full timeline is in the incident folder.

q1.instructions: Which line names the cause of the Thursday morning outage?
